verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on per-developer, per-branch or preview environments that would let a team ship in parallel. The Sandbox SDK's isolated containers and the Agents SDK's millions of instances are runtime building blocks for app workloads (running untrusted code, per-user agents), not development environments. That makes them adjacent features that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can spin up unlimited isolated environments so my whole team can ship simultaneously
